s1.syndrome_frame: A subcutaneous mass with recent growth and tenderness on the lower leg
salient_findings: Painful nodule on the lower part of the right leg
Enlargement and tenderness of the lesion over the past 6 months
Irregular, firm, erythematous, mobile, tender mass
key_facts: 40-year-old man
Lesion stable in size and painless for 4 years
No history of trauma
No personal or family history of malignancy
Mass measuring 3.5 × 2.3 × 1.7 cm
No popliteal or inguinal lymphadenopathy
Normal routine blood tests
Negative tests for hepatitis B surface antigen and HIV
Lobulated, tan-gray, firm mass on gross examination
Dermal tumor extending into the superficial subcutis
Nests and fascicles of spindle-shaped to epithelioid cells on light microscopy
Mitotic figures, including atypical forms, measured 7–8 per 10 high-power fields

shortlist.label: Dermatofibrosarcoma protuberans
shortlist.why_kept: Matches the description of a subcutaneous mass with recent growth and tenderness, and immunohistochemical staining showed strong positivity for vimentin

shortlist.label: Sclerosing epithelioid fibrosarcoma
shortlist.why_kept: The tumor's composition of nests and fascicles of spindle-shaped to epithelioid cells and the presence of mitotic figures are consistent with this diagnosis

shortlist.label: Pleomorphic hyalinizing angiectatic tumor
shortlist.why_kept: The tumor's location in the subcutis and its lobulated, tan-gray appearance are consistent with this rare sarcoma

shortlist.label: Myxofibrosarcoma
shortlist.why_kept: The tumor's dermal location and the presence of spindle-shaped to epithelioid cells are consistent with this diagnosis, although the lack of myxoid features is notable

shortlist.label: Undifferentiated pleomorphic sarcoma
shortlist.why_kept: The tumor's high mitotic rate and the presence of atypical forms are concerning for a high-grade sarcoma, and this diagnosis cannot be excluded without further testing

raw.rationale: The tumor's characteristics, such as a lobulated, firm mass with nests and fascicles of spindle-shaped to epithelioid cells and a collagenous stroma, along with strong positivity for vimentin and focal positivity for Melan-A and HMB-45, are consistent with Dermatofibrosarcoma protuberans.

rejected.label: Sclerosing epithelioid fibrosarcoma
rejected.why: The described tumor does not exhibit the typical sclerosing background and epithelioid morphology characteristic of Sclerosing epithelioid fibrosarcoma.

rejected.label: Pleomorphic hyalinizing angiectatic tumor
rejected.why: The tumor lacks the distinctive pleomorphic hyalinizing angiectatic features, including the presence of blood vessels with hyalinized walls.

rejected.label: Myxofibrosarcoma
rejected.why: The absence of a prominent myxoid component and curvilinear vessels in the tumor description makes Myxofibrosarcoma less likely.

rejected.label: Undifferentiated pleomorphic sarcoma
rejected.why: While the tumor exhibits some pleomorphic features, the presence of specific immunohistochemical markers and the tumor's morphology are more indicative of a specific sarcoma type, such as Dermatofibrosarcoma protuberans, rather than an undifferentiated pleomorphic sarcoma.
